label: The formulation of the VERIFICATION_PRINCIPLE_2 is not verifiable in the variant's sense
paraphrase: The formulation of the verification principle is not verifiable in the variant's sense. An open premise. For the 1946 criterion it is in tension with Church's trivialization (STMT-CHURCH-1949-TRIVIALIZATION): with Church's observation statements it can hold only if the principle's negation is directly verifiable.
